events.name: Wyrdeer, After

remembers.notice: It's calm. The red has gone out of its eyes. Something small and bright falls from behind its ear.

success.text: It lowers its great head beside you and breathes. Ine picks up the shard with a cloth. Ine: "It's a piece of something from the sky. It shouldn't have fallen." The forest shows you its paths.

success.text: It's gone. The frenzy stays in the forest edge, and Ine won't speak to you for a while.

events.name: The Beasts' Lookout
events.intro: A hunter on a ridge with a telescope and a field journal swollen with thirty years of notes. Thorne, not looking away from the telescope: "All three are in the region. First time in eleven years. Want to know where?" Thorne: "Don't answer yet. Everyone says yes. Then they chase, and the beasts are gone." Thorne: "I've never got close. I chase. That's my whole problem."

success.text: She marks three places on your map: thunder, ash, ripples. "Raikou wants you to wait. Entei wants you to stand still while it comes at you. Suicune wants to know what you did yesterday."
Thorne: "Because you didn't run up here." She marks the map, and writes a tip beside each place in small, careful letters. Then she goes back to the telescope.
Thorne shrugs. When she packs up and leaves, her field journal is still on the rock. Thirty years of notes. She hasn't noticed.

events.name: Thunder on a Clear Day

remembers.notice: Thorne's tip, in the margin of her map: "Raikou wants you to wait."

events.intro: Thunder rolls out of a perfectly clear sky. Once. Then nothing. The grass on the ridge is standing on end.

success.text: You wait. The air hums. Far off, on a rock, something yellow and enormous turns its head towards you, and doesn't run. Then it's gone, and the grass lies down.

branches.text: You wait. The air hums. Far off, on a rock, something yellow and enormous turns its head towards you, and doesn't run. Then it's gone, and the grass lies down. That's three. Somewhere, a tower is waiting.

success.text: The Ball hits empty rock. The sky is clear and silent again. It was never going to be that easy.

branches.text: The Ball hits empty rock. The sky is clear and silent again. It was never going to be that easy. Thorne finds you later. Thorne: "Three times. It's left the region. I don't blame it."

success.text: You run towards the sound. By the time you get there, there's only a scorched stone, still warm.

branches.text: You run towards the sound. By the time you get there, there's only a scorched stone, still warm. Thorne finds you later. Thorne: "Three times. It's left the region. I don't blame it."

events.name: A Trail of Ash

remembers.notice: Thorne's tip, in the margin of her map: "Entei wants you to stand still while it comes at you."

events.intro: A trail of ash across the path. Strange: the grass under it is already growing back, green through grey.

success.text: Heat rolls over the hill. Something huge comes at you out of the smoke. You don't move. It stops an arm's length away, looks at you, and turns away. The grass is greener where it stood.

branches.text: Heat rolls over the hill. Something huge comes at you out of the smoke. You don't move. It stops an arm's length away, looks at you, and turns away. The grass is greener where it stood. That's three. Somewhere, a tower is waiting.

success.text: You run. Behind you, a roar, and then the crackle of fire moving away. You never see it.

success.text: You hide behind a rock. The heat passes by, and keeps going. It didn't think you worth a look.

branches.text: You hide behind a rock. The heat passes by, and keeps going. It didn't think you worth a look. Thorne finds you later. Thorne: "Three times. It's left the region. I don't blame it."

events.name: Ripples on Still Water

remembers.notice: Thorne's tip, in the margin of her map: "Suicune wants to know what you did yesterday."

events.intro: A pond without a breath of wind on it. And yet, in the middle, rings of ripples, spreading, as if something just stepped off the water.

success.text: You kneel and put your hand in the water. It's very clear. On the far bank, something blue and white is watching you. It knows what you did yesterday. It stays a moment longer than it has to.

branches.text: You kneel and put your hand in the water. It's very clear. On the far bank, something blue and white is watching you. It knows what you did yesterday. It stays a moment longer than it has to. That's three. Somewhere, a tower is waiting.

success.text: You call out across the water. The ripples stop. The pond is just a pond again.

success.text: The Ball splashes into the middle of the pond and sinks. The ripples stop.

events.name: Raikou Is Here

remembers.notice: Thorne's journal is still in your bag. You never opened it.

success.text: Thorne stares at it. Thorne: "You kept my notes and brought them up here. You could have used them." She turns to the last page, blank, and holds out the pen. You sign it. Then the beast looks at you, and the battle is offered.

events.intro: The top floor of the Burned Tower. Raikou is waiting, as if it always knew you would come. Thorne, behind you, whispering: "Thirty years. Don't you dare throw anything until it looks at you." It looks at you. Then past you, at Thorne.

success.text: A fair battle. Raikou lowers its head.
Thorne walks up to it. It lets her touch its mane. She cannot speak. Then it turns back to you.

effects.label: Thorne touched its mane: your lead starts the battle a step ahead (+1 Speed)

success.text: It leaves, unhurried, down the stairs. Thorne doesn't understand why you did that. Then, slowly, she does. Word gets around.

events.name: Cresselia Is Here
events.intro: Fresh tracks. A crescent of silver light on the dew, fading as you look at it. A Legendary has been seen here, and it won't stay. A local, pointing: "It went that way. You'll never catch it. Nobody does."

success.text: You follow it all day, through places the map doesn't know.
You sit where the tracks end and rest. Nothing comes. But the waiting does you good.

branches.text: You sit where the tracks end and rest. At dusk, it comes back, and looks at you the way it looks at nobody else. A Sign.

success.text: You let it go. You'll remember the way it went: next time, you'll be a little closer.

events.name: Cresselia, Found
events.intro: There. Cresselia, right in front of you, close enough to touch. It hasn't decided yet whether to run.

success.text: It turns to face you.
You watch. It holds your eye a moment, then it's gone. You'll see it again.

events.name: The Tower of Legends
events.intro: A tower older than any map. Five floors. The door is open. Nobody is guarding it, which is somehow worse.

success.text: The door doesn't close behind you. It doesn't need to.
You walk past. The door stays open. It will wait.

events.name: The Tower of Legends
events.intro: It's Tower Week. The Tower of Legends has opened its door to everyone, blessed or not. Travellers queue at the bottom, whispering about what waits at the top.

success.text: You go in with the crowd. By the second floor, you're alone.
You leave the queue to the others.

events.name: Floor 1: The Offering
events.intro: An inscription: "Give, and be answered." A stone bowl, worn smooth by hands.

success.text: You place it in the bowl. A voice, very kind, from nowhere: "Thank you." It's enough to climb on.
You place it in the bowl. When you look again, there's a feather in its place, warm, and coloured like no bird you know.
You place it in the bowl and don't look back. Above you, all the way up, every stair lights up at once.
The bowl stays dark. The stairs are there anyway. Nobody said you had to.

events.name: Floor 2: Two Doors
events.intro: Two doors. Door A: "For those who travel with Legendary blood." Door B: "For those who travel with a friend."

success.text: It opens at a touch. Your Legendary goes through first, as if it knows the way.
It opens when you put your hand on your lead's head. You both go through together.

events.name: Floor 3: The Gauntlet of Echoes

remembers.notice: The hall is full of light.

success.text: Three shapes of light step down the stairs: Legendaries, or their echoes. One for each time a Legendary has looked your way.

remembers.notice: Something moves at the top of the stairs.

success.text: Two shapes of light step down the stairs: Legendaries, or their echoes. One for each time a Legendary has looked your way.

remembers.notice: Something moves at the top of the stairs.

success.text: A shape of light step down the stairs: Legendaries, or their echoes. One for each time a Legendary has looked your way.

events.intro: The Gauntlet of Echoes. A great empty hall, and stairs down from somewhere above. Nothing steps down. No Legendary has looked your way yet.

success.text: Your footsteps echo all the way across. The far stairs go up into the dark.

events.name: Floor 4: The Long Dark

remembers.notice: The stairs are lit, every one, all the way up.

success.text: You climb in the light. It costs nothing at all.

events.intro: The Long Dark. A staircase with no light. Each step costs something. You can hear your Pokémon breathing beside you.

success.text: You climb, step after step, until your legs shake. Then there's light above.
You sit on the stairs in the dark and rest, all of you together. It makes the climb one step longer.

events.name: Floor 5: The Summit of Legends

remembers.notice: Tower Week: a Legendary has come to the summit, a different one every year. It turns to look at you.

success.text: It cries out. Every climber below hears it.
It bows back. You will never forget that.

remembers.notice: Nobody waits for you. But on the wall, freshly carved, there's a Telling: a figure with a golden wheel, and a thousand arms.

success.text: "Before all of them, one. After all of them, one." You trace the carving with a finger. Arceus has been here.

remembers.notice: It's here. Your blessed Legendary, waiting at the top. A subtitle under its cry: "I have watched every one who climbed. You came up the stairs."

success.text: It spreads itself across the summit. The Presence.
It comes down the stairs and stands beside you. No battle. It was never going to need one.

events.intro: The summit. Wind, and stars, and an empty stone dais. Whatever waits here isn't waiting for you. Not yet.

success.text: You sit at the top of the world. When you climb down, you feel taller.

events.name: The Forgotten Badges

remembers.notice: The three old keepers have followed you down. They lie by the grave, one on each side, and one at its foot.

events.intro: The three forgotten badges grow warm in your bag, and a hidden door opens in the back of the central hall. Inside: the first Leader's grave, and a letter. The letter: "To whoever comes. I made the Gym so they would stop fighting in the streets. Did it work?"

success.text: You say it out loud, to the grave. "Yes. Mostly. They fight in Gyms now, with rules, and shake hands after." It feels true when you say it.
"No. Not all of it." The honest answer. You fold the letter and put it back. Somebody has to keep trying. It might as well be you.

You lay the three badges on the grave. They were hers. The stone warms under your hand, and a Telling appears in the dust on the wall: a figure with a golden wheel. (The badges' bonus stays with your team: the Gym remembers who came.)

events.name: The Letter to Future You
events.intro: A mailbox holds a letter addressed to you, in your own handwriting: "Don't trust the guide with the free shortcut. Feed the Poochyena. You'll know when. Don't sell the thing you're thinking of selling. You'll want it at the bridge." It's signed with your name, and dated one region from now.

success.text: You fold it into your pocket. The t's are crossed the way you cross them. You'll be careful.
Somebody's joke. You leave it in the box. But you remember every word.
There's a pen on a string. You write one line under it: "I'll try." You post it back into the same box.

events.name: The Bridge Toll

remembers.notice: Tucked under the toll-keeper's stool, a second letter, in your hand: "Thanks for writing. It helped. I'd forgotten I was ever that worried."

events.intro: A toll-keeper at a narrow bridge. "One item to cross. Any item. Rules is rules." You remember a letter: "You'll want it at the bridge."

success.text: You hand something over. The keeper waves you across. The letter was right, and you were ready.
There's a free way round, through the reeds. It takes a whole step longer.

events.name: The Letter You Write
events.intro: A mailbox. A blank sheet. A pen on a string. You know, without being told, that you're meant to write the letter now. Three warnings, from things that really happened on this road.

success.text: "Don't trust the guide with the free shortcut." You post it. The slot is dark, and deeper than a mailbox should be.

choices.label: Warn about the one you walked past.

success.text: "Stop for the one on their knees. You'll be in a hurry. Stop anyway." You post it. The slot is dark, and very deep.

choices.label: Warn about the fight you lost.

success.text: "The one who beats you knows your lead. Change it." You post it. The slot is dark, and very deep.
Just that. "Keep going. You make it further than you think." The slot takes it gently.

events.name: The Sealed Letter

remembers.notice: The address is in your own handwriting.

events.intro: A courier on a bicycle skids to a stop and hands you an envelope sealed with wax. Courier: "Don't open it yet. That's the instruction. Wait until the road gets hard." Courier: "Who's it from? No idea. Paid in advance. A long time in advance."

success.text: One line: "Too soon." And, inside, a small flask of spring water. You feel a little foolish.
It goes in the bottom of your bag. Some nights you can feel it there.
Courier: "Can't. It's been paid." They leave it on a rock and ride off. You pick it up. Of course you do.

events.name: The Letter, Opened
events.intro: Your party is hurt, all of them, worse than ever. And in the bottom of your bag, the sealed letter is glowing.

success.text: "I knew you would need this. Keep going. You make it further than you think." Behind the old signpost, just where it said, something is waiting.

events.name: Time Capsule
events.intro: A shovel left in a meadow next to a marker stone. Under it, a box labelled "Open in 20 years." It has been 30. Inside: an old trainer's Poké Ball, empty, and a note: "If you're reading this, you started again. Good."

success.text: You take what's in it. The note says one more thing, at the bottom: "Here's what I wish I'd known: everyone gets tired. Rest anyway."
You put something of your own in, and a line in your own hand, and fill in the hole. You mark the stone. One day, further down this road, you'll come back.
You put it all back. On the note, you add one line: "Not yet."

events.name: The Capsule, Again
events.intro: You know this meadow. The marker stone, the one you scratched a sign into, a whole region ago. The earth is soft.

success.text: Your line is there, in your own hand. It feels like a letter from someone younger. Beside it, what you left has been joined by something else, as if the box had been busy.

events.name: Professor's Time Machine

remembers.notice: The ring knows you. It opens wider, all on its own, and the air inside smells of the deep past.

success.text: Professor: "It's never done that." Something old roars, very far away. A Sign.

remembers.notice: The ring knows you. It opens wider, all on its own, and the air inside hums like a circuit.

success.text: Professor: "It's never done that." Something hums, very far ahead. A Sign.

events.intro: A humming machine in a lab: a ring of brass and glass, the height of a door. Inside it, the air's the wrong season. Professor Ignatia Sandoval-Reyes, in two pairs of glasses: "It doesn't move you. It moves a Pokémon. Sideways, really. Just for a battle." "It has to want to. I've a Jigglypuff that's declined eleven times."

success.text: Your lead looks at the ring. At you. It steps in. A snap like a sheet being shaken, and it comes out older than anything. Then a test, in the yard.
Your lead looks at the ring. At you. It steps in. A hum, and it comes out strange and bright. Then a test, in the yard.
Professor: "Wise. I've never been in it either."

events.name: The Oracle of the Road
events.intro: A room with no window and a bowl of water. A woman of no particular age opens her eyes. The Oracle: "I will speak one thing. You may carry it or leave it. I see what's likely, and say it aloud, and then it's a little more likely. Knowing changes the shape."

success.text: The Oracle: "Someone who's been kind to you will be on their knees in the road. You'll be in a hurry." She closes her eyes. "Stop."
The Oracle: "You'll lose something you thought was yours. Not for good. It'll feel like for good."
The Oracle: "You'll win one that you'd have thrown away, if you hadn't known it counted."
She smiles. "Then all three will surprise you. That's a gift, too."

events.name: Rainbow Rocket

remembers.notice: Giovanni sees the badge on your collar, and laughs. "So you're mine here too."

events.intro: A portal crackles open in the middle of the road. Giovanni steps through. Not this world's Giovanni. Giovanni: "In my world, I won. Everyone you know works for me." Giovanni: "I've come to see what a world looks like where someone stopped me."

success.text: Giovanni: "My winning team, then. Let's see if it wins here."
You walk him through the town. Children playing. A Gym with its doors open. He doesn't say a word the whole way. At the portal, he looks back once.
The portal fights back. Rainbow Rocket grunts pour through, wave after wave, while you push it shut.

events.name: Another Portal
events.intro: Another portal, crackling in the road where there was none. Someone else is coming through, with the same question in their eyes.

success.text: The light steadies. A figure steps out.

events.name: Rainbow Rocket: Maxie
events.intro: Maxie, from another world. Maxie: "In my world, the land swallowed the sea. I've come to see a world where someone stopped me."

success.text: Maxie: "Then show me."
You walk them through the town. They don't say a word. At the portal, they look back once.

events.name: Rainbow Rocket: Archie
events.intro: Archie, from another world. Archie: "In my world, the sea came over everything. Somebody here stopped it. Was that you?"

success.text: Archie: "Then show me."
You walk them through the town. They don't say a word. At the portal, they look back once.

events.name: Rainbow Rocket: Cyrus
events.intro: Cyrus, from another world. Cyrus: "In my world, there is no spirit. Show me what it is that stopped me here."

success.text: Cyrus: "Then show me."
You walk them through the town. They don't say a word. At the portal, they look back once.

events.name: Rainbow Rocket: Ghetsis
events.intro: Ghetsis, from another world. Ghetsis: "In my world, I rule. Every Pokémon is mine. And here? Here, someone said no."

success.text: Ghetsis: "Then show me."
You walk them through the town. They don't say a word. At the portal, they look back once.

events.name: Rainbow Rocket: Lysandre
events.intro: Lysandre, from another world. Lysandre: "In my world, the beautiful few are all that's left. Show me the ugly many who stopped me."

success.text: Lysandre: "Then show me."
You walk them through the town. They don't say a word. At the portal, they look back once.
